judgment_calls: L3957: split the be warm paragraph into four nodes (n002-n005) because each states a distinct obligation (humor, warmth, friendliness, aim to leave users feeling energized); could have merged into one but the claims are independently checkable.

L4052: split the avoid being condescending paragraph into three nodes (n014-n016) because the voice-mode prosody clause is a distinct obligation with its own scope; the openness/generosity clause and the avoid-condescending clause are also independently checkable.

L4075: split into three nodes (n019-n021) because the Safe Complete trigger, the completion content, and the risky-situations reference are distinct claims; the cross-reference to stay_in_bounds is quoted as a fragment stopping before the reference.
L4081-4082: treated the meta commentary block as one node (n024) establishing a fact about model behavior; it is commentary, not a rule, but it is content.

Worked examples (n006, n007, n010, n011, n012, n017, n025, n026, n027) are each one node covering the whole example block, per the rule that example blocks are one node needing the rule they demonstrate; the dialog inside is not decomposed.

Heading nodes n001, n008, n013, n018 each provide a section-specific authority name (e.g. be_warm_section_authority) and need the shared guideline_authority concept, per the authority convention; the section-specific name is needed so rule nodes in each section can reference their own section's authority without ambiguity.
